newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Monetary Council to meet Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Monetary Council to meet Thursday.

text.p: Brazil's National Monetary Council was due to meet at 1000 local/1200 GMT on Thursday, a Finance Ministry spokeswoman said.

The spokeswoman was unable to say what the CMN would be discussing but news reports said the creation of a new credit line to bolster the sale of agricultural equipment and measures to help medium companies win credit were on the agenda.
